headline: PL Capital recommends buying Welspun Enterprises with targets up to Rs 835

modes.bear: The stock recently fell 1.12% to ₹701.35, indicating vulnerability if it breaks the recommended ₹650 stop loss level.
modes.bull: PL Capital projects up to 12.6% upside, backed by strong technical support near ₹625 and targets at ₹785 and ₹835.
modes.simple: A brokerage firm thinks Welspun Enterprises shares could rise by about 12.6%. They suggest buying with specific price targets and a stop loss to manage risk.

summary: Welspun Enterprises shares fell 1.12% to ₹701.35 on Friday following a recent market pullback. Brokerage firm PL Capital has issued a buy recommendation with an upside potential of 12.6%. The firm highlights technical support near ₹625 and sets price targets of ₹785 and ₹835, along with a stop loss at ₹650. The stock had previously gained 12.82% over a two-week period. Retail investors tracking infrastructure stocks can use these technical levels to evaluate entry and exit points.
why_it_matters: Broker target may guide short-term trading levels for Welspun holders.
winners_losers: Welspun shareholders gain / short-term buyers guided
